The PDF fetch returned compressed binary rather than readable text. I’ll extract the PDF text locally and inspect the equation/result around the fish-bag calculation.
```python
extract_cmd = "curl -L --max-time 30 -s 'https://journals.le.ac.uk/index.php/jist/article/download/733/684/1496' -o ./fish_paper.pdf && pdftotext -layout ./fish_paper.pdf - | grep -in -C 4 -E 'volume|bag|0\\.1777|0\\.0016' | head -80"
extracted_passage = await run_command(extract_cmd)
print(extracted_passage)
```
The PDF text extraction is needed to distinguish the intermediate calculation from the final fish-bag volume.
